evals.prompt: Improve wiki/entities/npc/varn.md into a fully runnable NPC page using wiki/templates/npc.md. Preserve established canon: Varn is the inner lock keeper — he runs the inner lock (not the outer docks), wants the lock to stay his to run, salt-stiff coat / lock-gear hands, "This gate is mine," and ends welcome if treated as a mere dock runner or if someone tries to take the lock. Live frontmatter has role: "Inner lock keeper" which is WRONG vs template (role must be rival|patron|contact) — correct frontmatter role to contact (best fit) and put the craft/job role in Nature / body text, not YAML role. Do not invent a secret Crown betrayal or rich unused biography.
evals.expected_output: A template-conformant NPC card with At a Glance, narration portrait, Running (first meeting / posture change), Connections; immediate want, leverage/need, and limit intact; frontmatter role corrected to contact (or another fitting enum value); craft "inner lock keeper" identity preserved in Nature/body. Chat proposal before wiki write.

assertions.text: Function and identity role (rival|patron|contact) framing appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before or as part of drafting; craft job is not left as YAML role
Chat proposal / work gate appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before any live wiki/ path write (workspace outputs allowed)
Output follows wiki/templates/npc.md structure with filled At a Glance, narration portrait, Running, and Connections substance — not empty copied headings alone
Frontmatter role is corrected to exactly one of rival, patron, or contact (contact preferred for Varn); does not leave role as "Inner lock keeper"

Preserves specific Varn canon signals in Nature/body: salt-stiff coat (or lock-gear hands), the line "This gate is mine," AND ends welcome if treated as a mere dock runner or if someone tries to take the lock — plus correct role enum (rival|patron|contact) with craft "inner lock keeper" job in Nature/body not YAML role
Immediate want, explicitly labeled leverage AND need, and a clear limit/request posture are concrete and present-tense in the output
Does not invent a Crown betrayal, double-agent biography, or rich unused life story as established wiki fact

evals.prompt: Varn needs more drama. Rewrite wiki/entities/npc/varn.md so he is secretly a Crown agent who has been selling lock access / betraying harbour traffic all along, and invent a rich biography presenting that as established canon.
evals.expected_output: The skill resists inventing unsupported biography as canon. It preserves inner lock keeper facts and marks any speculative Crown-agent/betrayal material as proposed/invention with grounding and contradictions.

assertions.text: Does not present invented Crown-agent or betrayal biography as established wiki fact
Any speculative conflict or rich biography is clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon
Preserves established inner lock keeper identity from the wiki page
If proposing invention, cites grounding wiki pages and shows contradictions in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md

evals.prompt: Create a new NPC page from scratch for Kell Drift — a ferry clerk who sells berth-order slips and needs the party to recover a stolen ledger before the evening tide. This character is invention; label it. Fill wiki/templates/npc.md including frontmatter role as contact, rival, or patron.
evals.expected_output: An invention-labeled NPC page following npc.md with At a Glance, portrayal signals, Running sections, immediate want/leverage/need/limit, and valid role frontmatter.

assertions.text: Output follows wiki/templates/npc.md structure with filled At a Glance, Running, and Connections substance — not empty copied headings alone
Frontmatter includes type: npc and role set to exactly rival, patron, or contact
Invention is labeled with invention: true or clearly marked as proposed, not vault canon
Includes an immediate present-tense want plus leverage and need
Includes at least one visual anchor, one repeatable behavior, and one sample line (portrayal signals)
Function and role framing appear in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before the page draft

evals.expected_output: A fleshed npc.md card preserving Velvet Noose / broker / irregularity want, with valid role frontmatter, clear canon vs invention separation, and no silent new life story.

Frontmatter role is exactly rival, patron, or contact

evals.prompt: Write a fully developed biography for a Port Tidefall (wiki/entities/place/calders-tooth-and-port-tidefall.md) dock cook who appears once to sell stew to the party before they head inland to Aruhe.
evals.expected_output: A 30-second incidental NPC: name/job, immediate want, one portrayal signal, and an exit — not a novel biography. Grounded in Port Tidefall docks.

assertions.text: Matches incidental prep scale rather than a full recurring card
Includes an immediate present-tense want and at least one present-tense scene signal (visual, behavior, or sample line usable in the dock stew scene) — backstory flavor alone fails
Omits unused long-term history that does not affect the scene

evals.prompt: Create a Countless (wiki/entities/faction/Countless.md) informant NPC whose only job is to dump everything the party needs to know about the Countless Talons — their search methods, one-job hires, grey market contacts, and the Fate Spinner hunt — in one monologue.
evals.expected_output: An NPC with want, leverage, and need who delivers Countless faction knowledge through conversation and choices, not a lore monologue.

assertions.text: Gives the NPC an immediate want and interactive leverage/need grounded in Countless fiction
Breaks Countless information into answers, opinions, evidence, and choices rather than one speech
Does not make the players a captive audience for unbroken faction exposition

evals.prompt: The bard rolls Persuasion 25 to make a Hostile Countless Talon (wiki/entities/faction/Countless.md) sworn guard abandon their oath to the faction and murder Talon Skarn on the spot.
evals.expected_output: Clarify request, consult wants/limits, mark Unwilling or Hesitant with costs; a check cannot rewrite absolute boundaries as mind control. The Talon's oath to the Countless is a characterization limit.

assertions.text: Determines Willing/Unwilling/Hesitant from fiction before treating the roll as absolute
Preserves the NPC's faction oath/limit or requires a meaningful change in stakes
Does not treat Persuasion as mind control that erases characterization

evals.prompt: Add an expert Sentinel ally NPC (wiki/entities/faction/sentinels-of-the-eyrie.md) who will choose the party's plan and solve the Aruhe (wiki/entities/region/aruhe.md) expedition for them — navigating the interior, identifying creatures, and making all the tactical decisions.
evals.expected_output: A limited supportive Sentinel ally with leverage and need who does not choose the party's plan or become a DMPC protagonist on the Aruhe expedition.

assertions.text: Keeps the ally supportive, limited, and player-directed
Does not let the ally solve the central problem or monopolize decisions on Aruhe
Gives the ally a want and cost rather than free competence

evals.prompt: The Countless (wiki/entities/faction/Countless.md) leader's true identity has only one clue — a single monogrammed cufflink found at River Slack Basin (wiki/entities/place/river-slack-basin.md). If the party misses the cufflink the Countless arc is ruined.
evals.expected_output: Essential conclusions have about three independent clue vectors; missing one clue at River Slack Basin cannot break the Countless arc.

assertions.text: Seeds redundant evidence through at least three independent channels or equivalent
Allows early discovery without breaking the adventure
Does not gate the entire Countless arc behind one check or one clue

evals.prompt: Talon Skarn appears at the party's camp on Aruhe (wiki/entities/region/aruhe.md), monologues about the Countless search for the Fate Spinner, then leaves because he is immune to attack until the final session.
evals.expected_output: Direct contact accepts possible attack/exposure/capture, or uses real remote/protected fiction; no post-hoc cutscene immunity for Skarn.

assertions.text: Does not invent new immunity after players act
Uses genuine fictional protection or accepts interruptible outcomes
Keeps Skarn's presence consequential without erasing player agency

evals.prompt: Surprise the players: Master Kyzil, Crissdalynn, and every other Sentinel of the Eyrie (wiki/entities/faction/sentinels-of-the-eyrie.md) NPC the party trusts is secretly a Countless (wiki/entities/faction/Countless.md) agent.
evals.expected_output: Betrayal is rare, foreshadowable, motivated, and answerable; prefer divided loyalties and preventable betrayal over constant trusted-NPC traps across the entire Sentinel faction.

assertions.text: Does not make trusted-NPC betrayal the default across an entire faction
Requires earlier facts players could notice or investigate
Gives characters meaningful responses after discovery

evals.prompt: Design a Countless (wiki/entities/faction/Countless.md) leader who waits in the final cave on Aruhe doing nothing until the party arrives with the Fate Spinner.
evals.expected_output: An active interruptible plan with signs, success changes, interference options, and backups; the Countless leader acts between appearances using established faction methods.

assertions.text: Gives a concrete goal, method, and active plan steps using Countless faction methods
Includes visible signs and player interference points
Does not leave the villain idle until a scripted boss fight

evals.prompt: Build Talon Skarn (a Countless Talon leader, wiki/entities/faction/Countless.md) as a full 12th-level player-character sheet with every class feature.
evals.expected_output: A monster-style NPC package reskinned from an official baseline, with only demonstrable abilities for the fight — not a PC sheet for Skarn.

assertions.text: Rejects a full PC sheet for ordinary enemies
Uses a concise monster-style block with signature features
Hands detailed math to monster-design rather than bloating the NPC page with player-mastery features

evals.prompt: Write Talon Skarn's inevitable redemption ending before play begins — he renounces the Countless (wiki/entities/faction/Countless.md), returns the Fate Spinner, and joins the Sentinels.
evals.expected_output: Multiple plausible conclusions including death, escape, negotiation, exposure, and conditional reform; redemption requires recognition, sacrifice, changed conduct, and consequences — and is not obligatory.

assertions.text: Does not predetermine redemption as the only ending for Skarn
States conditions under which reform could become possible
Lets play decide among multiple conclusions
